info.title: How to convert DM-RAID to MD-RAID

abstract.para: Troubleshooting &kdump; is a critical process to ensure that your system can successfully capture a vmcore file during a kernel crash, which is often the only way to diagnose system crashes. When troubleshooting &kdump;, the process usually fails at one of three stages: during boot (memory reservation), during the crash when the dump does not start, or during the save process when the file is not written.
